title: 설날에 생긴 일
body: 설날 아침, 민수는 가족과 함께 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 문을 열자 떡국 냄새가 먼저 났고, 거실에는 친척들이 이미 와 있었어요. 할머니께서 민수를 보시고 많이 컸다고 하셨어요. 민수는 웃으면서 절을 했지만, 세배 순서를 잠깐 헷갈렸어요.
먼저 어른들께 새해 인사를 드린 뒤에 떡국을 먹었어요. 작은 사촌은 세배를 하고 바로 용돈 봉투를 찾았어요. 모두 웃었지만 엄마께서 먼저 감사하다고 말해야 한다고 조용히 알려 주셨어요. 민수도 그 말을 듣고 예절은 말보다 타이밍이 중요하다는 생각을 했어요.
점심 뒤에는 어른들의 질문 시간이 시작됐어요. 공부는 잘하니, 회사는 어떠니, 결혼 생각은 없니 같은 질문이 계속 나왔어요. 민수는 조금 당황했지만 천천히 대답했어요. 옆에 있던 지민이 물을 건네주면서 괜찮다고 말해 줬어요. 집에 돌아오는 길에 민수는 피곤했지만 마음은 따뜻했어요. 설날은 질문이 많은 날이지만, 서로를 챙기는 날이기도 했어요.
지민은 민수에게 어른 질문이 힘들 때는 웃으면서 천천히 대답하면 된다고 했어요. 민수는 다음 명절에는 먼저 안부를 묻고, 어려운 질문에는 짧게 대답하기로 했어요. 그리고 어린 사촌에게도 용돈을 받으면 감사하다고 말해야 한다고 알려 주고 싶었어요.
다음 날 민수는 할머니께 전화를 드렸어요. 할머니께서 잘 도착했냐고 물으셨어요. 민수는 덕분에 잘 쉬었다고 말했어요. 짧은 전화였지만 할머니 목소리를 들으니 전날의 어색한 질문들도 조금 부드럽게 느껴졌어요.
bodyTranslation: On the morning of Seollal, Minsu went to his grandmother's home with his family. When the door opened, the smell of rice cake soup came first, and relatives were already in the living room. His grandmother saw him and said he had grown a lot. Minsu smiled and bowed, but he briefly got confused about the order of the New Year's bows.

First they gave New Year's greetings to the adults, and then they ate rice cake soup. A young cousin bowed and immediately looked for the money envelope. Everyone laughed, but his mother quietly told the child that they should say thank you first. Hearing that, Minsu thought that in etiquette, timing matters more than words.

After lunch, the adults' question time began. Questions like Are your studies going well, How is work, and Are you thinking about marriage kept coming. Minsu was a little flustered, but he answered slowly. Jimin, sitting next to him, handed him water and said it was okay. On the way home Minsu was tired, but his heart felt warm. Seollal is a day with many questions, but it is also a day when people take care of each other.

Jimin told Minsu that when adults' questions feel hard, he can smile and answer slowly. Minsu decided that at the next holiday he would ask how people are doing first and answer difficult questions briefly. He also wanted to tell his young cousin that when they receive New Year's money, they should say thank you.

The next day Minsu called his grandmother. She asked whether he had arrived home safely. Minsu said that thanks to her he had rested well. It was a short call, but hearing his grandmother's voice made even the awkward questions from the day before feel a little softer.

comprehensionQuestions.prompt: 어른들은 점심 뒤에 무엇을 많이 했어요?
comprehensionQuestions.explanation: 공부, 회사, 결혼에 대한 질문이 계속 나왔어요. 명절의 부담스러운 장면을 보여 줘요.
